title: Chomp task (board/tasks/<id>/task.yaml)
description: One card on the board. Written only by board/store.mjs; agents never write it.

ref.description: The card ID people see, e.g. AOS-12.

redesign.description: Redesigning an existing screen: the planner reads the current one first.

kind.description: full goes through Development; design ends after Refinement. Missing means full.

library.description: For a profile with figma.libraries: the id of the design system this task designs with.

figma_file.description: The Figma file the owner gave for this task: its work file, overriding the profile's figma.work_file.

profile.description: profiles/<name>.yaml this task is bound to.

account.description: Claude account the agents run as (claude-profiles directory, or default).

paused_from.description: The status a paused card returns to on Start.

resume_pending.description: Start resumes the interrupted session instead of starting fresh.

activity.description: What the agent is doing right now, while working.

kind.description: connection/missing_agent recheck every minute; agent waits for a chat reply; error waits for Retry.

needs.description: What the owner can give the card from the board to unblock it.

sessions.description: column id (or <column>:edit) → SDK session id, so chat replies resume the same agent.
